params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly replaces all raw types with parameterized generic types, such as changing List to List<?> and Set to Set<?>, and also updates method signatures to use Class<?> instead of raw Class. These changes directly address the SonarQube warning about raw types without introducing unrelated modifications. The only minor deviation is the use of List<Object> and Set<Object> in some casts, which is acceptable and does not detract from the fix. No unrelated or unnecessary changes are present.

Score: 3
